responsibility_separation.formatter: selects only declared layout actions over an admitted lossless CST and proves parse-format-parse AST equivalence plus idempotence
responsibility_separation.incremental_parser: selects, reparses, and conditionally splices one deterministic CST owner without changing language admission
responsibility_separation.lsp: binds every request and result to one document revision, source role/profile, parse snapshot, and contract digest set
responsibility_separation.checker: never repairs CST structure or clears recovery taint
responsibility_separation.canonical_ast_hir: consume only recovery-free sealed output; incremental and tooling handles are excluded from canonical identity
responsibility_separation.runtime_backend: no formatter, LSP, reparse, or tooling identity survives into MIR, xVM, Cranelift, ABI, or runtime state

formatting_disposition_function.input_domain: exact 656 rows of grammar-production-disposition-registry-r1 after the R77 atomic surface cutover

admission: the rule has one canonical owner path and field
the selected source profile admits the owner
the rule changes layout or a declared equivalent spelling only
comments and trivia retain one lossless owner
parse-format-parse normalized AST identity is equal
a second formatting pass emits zero edits
explicit_owner_rule_gate.composition_law: token spellings and comments retain exact byte ownership; only whitespace or layout slots named by one unique parent owner rule may change
explicit_owner_rule_gate.line_break_boundary_preservation: a LineBreakBoundary or comment-owned newline remains when removing or moving it could change parsing

recovery_and_malformed_cst.fixit_scope: exact action admitted by recovery contract; never invent semantic source

owns: line map and negotiated position encoding

recipe: ordered child CstContentId or exact token kind and bytes

CstOccurrenceId.current_cst_node_id_mapping: CstOccurrenceId = snapshot-qualified occurrence of current CstNodeId(SourceFileId, green_path, CstKind, byte_range)

IncrementalNodeHandleId.reuse: preserved only by one accepted one-to-one NodeReuseReceipt

required_proofs: node is outside the replaced interval or is an unchanged child of the accepted splice
parent reuse is proven or node is the selected reparse root
mapping is unique in both directions

forbidden_identity_conflations: source byte offset alone == stable node identity
tooling identity participates in R23 Actor or binding identity preimage

incremental_reparse.edit_coordinate_transform: apply ordered nonoverlapping edits simultaneously against one old snapshot and map the selected old half-open owner interval to one new half-open reparse interval after lexical-envelope expansion
incremental_reparse.boundary_insertion_rule: an insertion at an owner boundary belongs to the smallest owner whose lexical entry and exit states remain exact; otherwise ascend
incremental_reparse.concurrent_edit_publication: atomic compare-and-swap on expected old DocumentRevisionId and ParseSnapshotId; exactly one competing edit may publish
incremental_reparse.lexical_expansion: expand each edit through the smallest scanner-mode envelope whose entry and exit lexical states can be recomputed exactly
reparse_owner_eligibility: a lossless CST structural owner with one exact DPG and ParserContext reparse entry and exit contract
an exact Pratt or scanner external entry with a declared parent splice slot
incremental_reparse.owner_selection: choose the smallest eligible old CST owner containing every lexically expanded edit interval; ties are impossible because CST ownership is a tree
mandatory_ascent_conditions: entry or exit scanner state changed outside the owner
parser goal or boundary digest changed
old or new recovery taint crosses the owner boundary
splice partition or unchanged-sibling proof failed
selected external entry lacks one parent splice slot
parser authority digest set, source role, activation profile, scanner goal, or frontend contract digest changed
boundary trivia or a contextual newline is owned outside the selected subtree
incremental_reparse.ascent: move to the nearest eligible parent and retry exactly once per ancestor
incremental_reparse.root_fallback: reparse the selected source root; if it remains tainted, return analysis CST and no canonical AST seal
splice_gate: the reparse consumes exactly the deterministic new interval mapped from the selected old owner interval
entry and exit scanner states match the new surrounding snapshot
source role, activation profile, parser authority digest set and frontend contract digests match
the child byte partition is total, ordered and nonoverlapping
unchanged siblings have one-to-one reuse receipts
the new subtree has the selected structural CST owner
canonical AST normalization succeeds only when recovery taint is empty
incremental_reparse.snapshot_read_lease: a formatter, parser, LSP, code-action, or reuse-receipt operation retains its exact ParseSnapshotId until result completion
incremental_reparse.snapshot_reclamation_gate: no current-document, active request, or reuse-receipt lease remains
incremental_reparse.late_result_publication: publish only when expected DocumentRevisionId and ParseSnapshotId are still current
incremental_reparse.recovery_episode_identity: RecoveryEpisodeId(ParseSnapshotId, parser-boundary occurrence identity, ordered provenance)
incremental_reparse.diagnostic_parity: incremental diagnostics equal a full parse of the same ParseSnapshotId after global recovery merge and cascade suppression
incremental_reparse.diagnostic_merge_order: canonical recovery ordering key; worker completion order is ignored
incremental_reparse.evaluation_or_parse_order: source byte order; no parallel result may change selected owner, diagnostic order, or reuse mapping

range_format.selection: smallest recovery-free structural format owner wholly containing the requested byte range
range_format.token_split: expand to complete token boundaries before owner selection

request_binding: line map digest and negotiated position encoding
lsp_snapshot_fence.result_binding: echo the exact request binding and source bytes sha256
lsp_snapshot_fence.semantic_tokens: exact tokens plus recovery-free semantic fragments only
lsp_snapshot_fence.rename_navigation: canonical identities only for recovery-free sealed fragments; analysis-only navigation remains explicitly tainted
lsp_snapshot_fence.code_action: exact diagnostic and recovery-contract action only
lsp_snapshot_fence.internal_span_domain: zero-based half-open byte intervals over the exact snapshot source-byte buffer
lsp_snapshot_fence.position_conversion: negotiated LSP position encoding plus snapshot line-map digest maps to one exact internal byte boundary
lsp_snapshot_fence.replacement_and_action_binding: expected old DocumentRevisionId, ParseSnapshotId, half-open interval, and old interval sha256

diagnostic_policy.primary_diagnostic_selection: retain the parser/checker primary diagnostic for source errors; tooling protocol failures return a typed tooling result until separate diagnostic authority
tooling_failure_precedence: AST equivalence, idempotence, splice, and reuse proof
